gettingAround.en: A driving trip. Times are local. Keep bags in the trunk at trailheads.
gettingAround.zh: 这是一趟自驾。时间都是当地时间。停在步道口时，行李放进行李箱。

title.en: Thanksgiving · land in Phoenix, Rock Springs turkey lunch, Bell Rock, Airport Mesa sunset, Rascal dinner
title.zh: 感恩节 · 落地 Phoenix → Rock Springs 火鸡午餐 → Bell Rock → Airport Mesa 日落 → Rascal 晚餐

notes.en: Land at Terminal 4 and collect checked bags if you have them
notes.zh: 落地 T4，取托运行李（如有）

note.zh: � T4 出口跟 'PHX Sky Train' 标志 → 坐到 Rental Car Center 站（免费，约 5–8 分钟一班），出站即 Avis 柜台

notes.en: Pick up the car at 12:00 PM. The driver brings a physical license and a physical credit card
notes.zh: 取车（订单 12:00 PM 取；主驾，带实体驾照+实体信用卡+）

note.zh: � I-17 N 约 40 mi → Exit 242（Black Canyon City）→ 右转 Old Black Canyon Hwy 1 分钟；店前免费停车场

notes.en: Thanksgiving lunch, the traditional turkey plate, 11 AM–3 PM, then choose a pie at PieBox
notes.zh: 感恩节午餐（传统火鸡大餐，11 AM–3 PM），饭后在 PieBox 挑派

hours.en: Official notice: Thanksgiving 11/26 turkey dinner 11 AM–3 PM
hours.zh: 官网公告：11/26 感恩节 11 AM–3 PM 火鸡大餐，建议订位

text.en: 1918 station building, fireplace, and stone steps by the creek garden
text.zh: 1918 年驿站老楼，壁炉+溪边花园石阶

text.en: PieBox bakery: watch the pies through the window
text.zh: PieBox 派铺：橱窗看烘焙

text.en: The Thanksgiving turkey plate includes a slice of pie
text.zh: 感恩节火鸡套餐自带一片派
Thanksgiving Dinner（11/26 限定套餐：turkey、garlic mashed potatoes、gravy、yams、cornbread stuffing、cranberry sauce、dinner roll + a slice of pie）
JD Pecan Pie（招牌 Jack Daniel's 山核桃派）

text.en: Banana Cream Pie / Apple Crumb Pie
text.zh: Banana Cream Pie / Apple Crumb Pie

backups.name: Matt's Big Breakfast (PHX T4, B concourse)
backups.nameEn: Matt's Big Breakfast (PHX T4, B concourse)

text.zh: The Chop & Chick（猪排+2 蛋）
Griddlecakes
Thanksgiving Day Menu（官网页面，菜品现场看）

note.zh: � I-17 N → Exit 298 → AZ-179 N 约 8 mi → 右侧 Courthouse Vista / Bell Rock Trailhead 停车场；用 行程主人 的 America the Beautiful 年票挂后视镜即可（不用另买 Red Rock Pass）

notes.en: Walk the Bell Rock Pathway to the base. The lower slope is gentle, about 1.5 km round trip, 45 minutes
notes.zh: 走 Bell Rock Pathway 到钟形岩底部，可爬下层缓坡（往返约 1.5 km，45 分钟）

text.en: Bell Rock and Courthouse Butte in one frame
text.zh: 钟形岩正面+Courthouse Butte 双岩同框

text.en: Village of Oak Creek from the lower rock slope
text.zh: 下层岩坡上看 Village of Oak Creek 全景
Sedona 能量漩涡（vortex）点之一

note.zh: � AZ-179 N → Y 形环岛左转 89A W → 左转 Airport Rd 上山 0.5 mi（感恩节下午 179 环岛常堵，预留 10 分钟）

notes.en: Sunset, about 5:14 PM on 11/26. A 10-minute walk up the start of Airport Loop reaches the saddle
notes.zh: 日落（11/26 日落约 5:14 PM）。可走 Airport Loop 起头 10 分钟到鞍部取景

text.en: Cathedral Rock, Bell Rock, and Thunder Mountain turning red at sunset, all in one view
text.zh: 360° 看 Cathedral Rock、Bell Rock、Thunder Mountain 被夕阳染红

text.en: Stay 15 minutes after sunset for blue hour
text.zh: 日落后 15 分钟的 'blue hour' 别急着走

text.en: One of Sedona's four main vortex sites
text.zh: Sedona 四大 vortex 之一

note.zh: � Airport Rd 下山 → 89A W 1.5 mi → 右转进 The Wilde Resort；度假村免费停车

name.en: Rascal Modern American Diner & Bar (The Wilde Resort & Spa)
name.zh: Rascal Modern American Diner & Bar (The Wilde Resort & Spa)

notes.en: Thanksgiving dinner
notes.zh: 感恩节晚餐

hours.en: Confirmed. The Thanksgiving menu is on the official PDF
hours.zh: 已订；感恩节菜单已公布（官网 PDF）

text.zh: Roast Turkey Dinner（感恩节限定：Red Bird 火鸡、sage bread stuffing、green beans、whipped sweet potatoes、gravy、cranberry relish、dinner roll）
Butternut Squash Soup
Pumpkin Pie with Whipped Cream
Shrimp & Grits（常规晚餐菜单招牌，2022 'Best Twist on an Original'）
Thanksgiving Day Menu

note.zh: � 89A W 0.1 mi 隔壁（也可走路 3 分钟）

notes.en: Photo stop at the turquoise M, the only one of its color. Leave after the picture
notes.zh: 拍照：全球唯一绿松石色 M 标志（拍完就走，不用吃）

hours.en: The sign can be photographed any time. Thanksgiving hours inside the shop were not checked
hours.zh: 招牌 24h 可拍（店内感恩节营业时间未核实）

text.en: Turquoise M. Sedona does not allow a yellow one
text.zh: 绿松石色 M（Sedona 市规不准用黄色）

note.zh: � 89A W 0.9 mi，右侧；酒店免费停车

notes.en: Check in for 2 nights. Bags stay in the trunk all day. At trailheads, put things in the trunk, not in sight
notes.zh: 入住（2 晚）。行李整天在后备箱：停步道口时把东西收进后备箱、不放车内显眼处

hours.en: Confirmed. The hotel said check-in is available from 3 PM
hours.zh: 已订（酒店回信 3 PM 起可入住）

notes.en: Thanksgiving: the Sedona shuttle, Chapel of the Holy Cross, and Montezuma Castle are closed, so none of them are on this day
notes.zh: 感恩节：Sedona Shuttle 停运、Chapel of the Holy Cross 闭馆、Montezuma Castle 闭馆 → 本日都不排

notes.en: Bags stay in the car. Put them in the trunk before a trailhead
notes.zh: 行李在车上：停步道口前把东西收进后备箱

notes.en: Sunset about 5:14 PM
notes.zh: 日落约 5:14 PM

title.en: Full Sedona day · Devil's Bridge first shuttle, Tlaquepaque and Hideaway House, the Chapel, Uptown, Cathedral Rock, Cowboy Club
title.zh: Sedona 全天 · Devil's Bridge 首班车 → Tlaquepaque + Hideaway House → Chapel of the Holy Cross → Uptown → Cathedral Rock → Cowboy Club

notes.en: Leave. Breakfast is not included
notes.zh: 出发（不含早餐）

note.zh: � 89A E 1.5 mi，左侧；店前免费停车

notes.en: Breakfast. It opens at 6 AM and there is usually no wait then
notes.zh: 早餐（6 AM 开门，这时段基本不用等）

text.zh: #101 Jelly, Peanut Butter and Banana（101 号煎蛋卷，Elvis 传说那款）
#49 Green Chile and Cheese（青辣椒芝士煎蛋卷）
Huevos Rancheros（green chile sauce）
Miley's Burrito（牛肉+豆，enchilada sauce，偏辣）
Biscuits & Country Gravy
Pancakes（2 或 3 片）

note.zh: � 89A W 2 mi → 右转 Upper Red Rock Loop Rd → 905 号停车场（免费，禁过夜）
� Sedona Shuttle Route 11 首班 7:00（每 30 分钟一班，免费；11/19–11/29 每天运行，感恩节当天除外）→ Dry Creek Vista 7:10

notes.en: Devil's Bridge is about 6.4 km round trip (1.6 km of dirt road plus 1.6 km of trail each way). The last 400 m of steps are steep, and the bridge photo has a queue
notes.zh: Devil's Bridge 往返约 6.4 km（土路 1.6 km + 步道 1.6 km，单程），最后 400 m 石阶较陡；桥上拍照排队

hours.en: The trail is open all day. The shuttle runs on 11/27
hours.zh: 步道全天开放；Shuttle 11/27 运行（官网节假日表）

text.en: Stand on the natural stone arch, Sedona's largest sandstone arch
text.zh: 站上天然石拱桥（Sedona 最大的砂岩拱）

text.en: Seven Sisters in the morning side light
text.zh: 清晨侧光下的 Seven Sisters 远景

text.en: A side path under the bridge for the photo of people on the arch
text.zh: 桥下侧路可拍'人在桥上'的全景

note.zh: � Route 11 回程 9:40 → 9:58 到 Park & Ride（下一班 10:10）
� 89A E 穿过 West Sedona → Y 环岛右转 AZ-179 S 0.3 mi → Tlaquepaque 右侧；Tlaquepaque 免费停车场（对面也有）

notes.en: Walk the Mexican colonial-style arts village. Shops open about 10 AM
notes.zh: 逛墨西哥殖民风艺术村（商店约 10 AM 开）

hours.zh: 每天 10 AM–5 PM（店家各异）

text.en: Chapel courtyard, small chapel, and bell tower
text.zh: Chapel 小礼拜堂与钟楼庭院

text.en: Stone fountain court under the sycamores
text.zh: 梧桐树下的石砌喷泉庭院
画廊街（Mountain Trails 等）

note.zh: � 沿 AZ-179 往北 450 m（过 Oak Creek 桥）到 Hideaway House

notes.en: Lunch. Arrive at the 11 AM opening, walk in, and ask for a terrace seat facing the red rocks
notes.zh: 午餐（11 点开门就到，walk-in，要露台位看 Oak Creek 红岩）

hours.en: Official site: daily from 11 AM. Parties of this size are walk-in only
hours.zh: 官网：每天 11 AM 起；2–只接 walk-in

text.zh: Roma 或 Blanco Classico（14" 招牌披萨；Blanco Classico 是 House favorite 白披萨）
Meat Lasagna
Hideaway Antipasto（House favorite 沙拉）
Chicken Mole' Enchiladas
Javelina Margarita（+prickly pear）
Village Nut Brown Ale
Tlaquepaque Burger
14" wood-fired pizza

segments.from: Hideaway House (walk back to car at Tlaquepaque)

note.zh: � 回 Tlaquepaque 取车 6 分钟 → � AZ-179 S 3 mi → Chapel Rd 环岛左转 0.6 mi；只有 45 个车位在上坡路右侧；满了就在坡顶回转处下客，司机在坡下等

notes.en: Walk up the ramp into the chapel, stay quiet, then the outer terrace for the red rocks
notes.zh: 上坡道进礼拜堂（保持安静），再到外平台看红岩

hours.en: Official site: daily 9 AM–5 PM, last entry 4:45. Third-party listings said Thanksgiving is closed, so this visit is Friday
hours.zh: 官网：每天 9 AM–5 PM，最后入场 4:45；第三方：感恩节闭馆 → 改周五

text.en: The 90-foot cross face set between two red-rock peaks
text.zh: 嵌在双峰红岩之间的 90 英尺十字立面

text.en: Floor-to-ceiling windows inside the chapel, facing the red-rock valley
text.zh: 礼拜堂内落地窗正对红岩谷

text.en: Terrace view of Bell Rock, Courthouse Butte, and Cathedral Rock
text.zh: 平台看 Bell Rock / Courthouse Butte / Cathedral Rock

note.zh: � AZ-179 N 3.5 mi → Y 环岛右转 89A N → Uptown 公共停车场（Forest Rd 停车楼）

name.en: Uptown Sedona (Main St · Snoopy Rock view)
name.zh: Uptown Sedona (Main St · Snoopy Rock view)

notes.en: Walk Uptown and look at Snoopy Rock. Cowboy Club is on this street
notes.zh: Uptown 主街散步 + 看 Snoopy Rock；确认晚餐 Cowboy Club 位置（就在主街）

text.en: Snoopy Rock and Lucy Rock silhouettes from the main street
text.zh: 主街看 Snoopy Rock / Lucy Rock 红岩剪影

text.en: Old western storefronts on the Sedona Heritage side streets
text.zh: Sedona Heritage 小街两侧的西部老店面

text.en: The Cowboy Club sign, Birthplace of Cowboy Artists of America
text.zh: Cowboy Club 门口 'Birthplace of Cowboy Artists of America' 牌子

note.zh: � 89A S → Y 环岛 → AZ-179 S 0.6 mi → 1294 SR-179 Park & Ride（免费）
� Sedona Shuttle Route 15（每 15 分钟，最后一班去程 4:30）→ Cathedral Rock 站

notes.en: About 2 km round trip, 225 m of climb. The upper part is a scramble. Reach the saddle for side light, and start down at 4:40
notes.zh: 往返约 2 km，爬升 ~225 m，后半段要手脚并用攀岩坡；到鞍部（saddle）看夕阳侧光，4:40 就要往下走

hours.en: The shuttle runs on 11/27. Last Route 15 bus back is 5:12 PM
hours.zh: Shuttle 11/27 运行，Route 15 末班回程 5:12 PM（官网）

text.en: Cathedral spires close on both sides of the saddle
text.zh: 鞍部两侧红岩'大教堂'尖塔近在眼前

text.en: Village of Oak Creek and Bell Rock looking back
text.zh: 回望 Village of Oak Creek 与 Bell Rock

text.en: The walls are reddest from 4 to 5 PM. Sunset is about 5:14
text.zh: 下午 4–5 点岩壁最红（日落约 5:14）

note.zh: � Route 15 回程（最晚 5:12 PM 末班，误了就要走 ~3 km 公路回去）
� AZ-179 N → 89A W 3.5 mi → 酒店；换掉登山装（傍晚，非午休）

notes.en: Back to the room to change, about 40 minutes in the evening
notes.zh: 回房换衣服（傍晚 40 分钟）

note.zh: � 89A E 4 mi → Uptown；停 Forest Rd 停车楼

notes.en: Dinner
notes.zh: 晚餐

hours.en: Official site: daily 11 AM–9 PM except Christmas. Seatings are 5:00 and 6:30 only
hours.zh: 官网：每天 11 AM–9 PM（圣诞除外）；订位仅 5:00 / 6:30

text.zh: Trail Boss Sampler（Cactus Fries、Rattlesnake Sausage、Bison Meatballs、BBQ Ribs + pretzel stick）
House Smoked Prime Rib（The Weekend Roast：周五–周日 4 PM 后限量）
Butcher's Cut of Bison（当日野牛部位，问服务员）
Famous Cowboy margarita + Prickly Pear

text.en: Côtelettes d'Agneau Roasted Double Lamb Chops
text.zh: Côtelettes d'Agneau Roasted Double Lamb Chops（三块双骨羊排）
French Onion Soup Gratinee
Flaming Bananas Foster（桌边点火甜点）
Elote
Smoked Pork Cheeks
Lamb Adobo

note.zh: � 89A W 4 mi 回酒店

notes.en: The shuttle runs on 11/27. First Route 11 bus is 7:00. Last Route 15 bus back is 5:12 PM. Do not miss it
notes.zh: Shuttle 11/27 运行：Route 11 首班 7:00；Route 15 末班回程 5:12 PM（必须赶上）

notes.en: The chapel lot has 45 spaces. If it is full, get dropped at the top of the hill
notes.zh: Chapel 停车只有 45 位，满了就坡顶下客

title.en: Oak Creek Canyon to Flagstaff, then the South Rim (Mather, Trail of Time, El Tovar, Desert View Watchtower, Lipan Point at sunset), dinner at Cameron, then Page
title.zh: Oak Creek Canyon → Flagstaff → 大峡谷南缘（Mather · Trail of Time · El Tovar · Desert View 塔楼 · Lipan Point 日落）→ Cameron 晚餐 → Page

notes.en: Check out and leave at 8:00. Pack the car the night before
notes.zh: 退房出发 8:00（行李前一晚装好车）

segments.to: Macy's European Coffeehouse (via Oak Creek Canyon)

note.zh: � 89A E 穿 Uptown → 89A N 一路开过 Oak Creek Canyon（之字弯段车窗看风景，不停 Oak Creek Vista）→ I-17 N 并入 Milton Rd → 市中心 Beaver St。11 月清晨之字弯可能结冰：结冰就改 AZ-179 S → I-17 N；市中心路边计时/免费小停车场

notes.en: Takeout breakfast, 15 minutes. It opens at 6:30 AM. Eat in the car
notes.zh: 早餐外带 15 分钟（6:30 AM 开），车上吃

hours.zh: 官网：周五–周日 6:30 AM–4 PM

text.zh: House-roasted coffee / Cafe Mexicano（cappuccino+肉桂肉豆蔻）
French cinnamon roll（柜台糕点，以当天为准）
Breakfast Sandwich（croissant + steamed eggs）
Biscuit & Gravy（素食 gravy，本地招牌）
Chilaquiles（red / green / Christmas sauce，可加 chorizo）
Egg bagel（早餐蛋贝果）
Deli Sandwich

segments.to: Grand Canyon South Entrance → Mather Point lots (Visitor Center)

note.zh: � Humphreys St → US-180 N（Kendrick Park 林区）→ AZ-64 N 过 Tusayan → 南入口约 10:20 到。用年票走最左边 Lane 1（持票车道，排队较短）；出发前看 NPS 南入口摄像头。时间表已留 25 分钟排队缓冲 → 跟 Visitor Center 标志停 Lot 1–4

notes.en: First look at the canyon: a 5-minute walk from the visitor center to the Mather Point rail
notes.zh: 第一眼大峡谷：从 Visitor Center 走 5 分钟到 Mather Point 栏杆平台

text.en: A point of rock over the canyon, facing O'Neill Butte
text.zh: 伸出峡谷的岩岬平台，正对 O'Neill Butte

text.en: Looking down toward Bright Angel Canyon
text.zh: 向下望 Bright Angel Canyon 方向

text.en: The first view, with no sense of scale
text.zh: 第一次看峡谷的'没有尺度感'

note.zh: � Rim Trail 往西 1.3 km（平坦铺装），沿途峡谷边

notes.en: Geology museum windows and outdoor Yavapai Point. Keep it to 10 minutes
notes.zh: 地质馆大玻璃窗+室外 Yavapai Point（缩短到 10 分钟）

hours.en: Open in the daytime. In November about 8–6

text.en: A short stretch of the Colorado River visible through the big window
text.zh: 大窗看得到谷底 Colorado River 一小段

text.en: The relief model that explains the canyon
text.zh: 立体地形模型看懂峡谷结构

note.zh: � Rim Trail 'Trail of Time' 往西 2.3 km 到 Grand Canyon Village（每 1 m 代表 100 万年的地质时间线），到 Verkamp's → El Tovar

notes.en: Fifteen minutes before lunch: Hopi House next to El Tovar, then two minutes west to Lookout Studio on the rim
notes.zh: 午餐前 15 分钟：El Tovar 隔壁的 Hopi House，往西 2 分钟到崖边 Lookout Studio

hours.en: Open in the daytime. Shops reopen gradually from 11/20
hours.zh: 日间开放（店铺 11/20 起陆续恢复）

text.en: Hopi House, designed by Mary Colter in 1905
text.zh: Mary Colter 设计的 Hopi House（1905）

text.en: Lookout Studio, a stone room hanging on the rim
text.zh: Lookout Studio 石屋挂在崖边的观景台

note.zh: � Rim Trail 往东 200 m 回 El Tovar

notes.en: Lunch at 12:45. Confirmed

hours.en: NPS update on 11/17: from 11/20, lunch is 11–2:30

text.zh: Navajo Taco（Chef's Recommendation：现炸 fry bread）
El Tovar's Signature Chili（Beef Chili）
Signature Beef Stroganoff
Fred Harvey Double Bacon Cheeseburger
Pot Roast
Tortilla Black Bean Soup
Elk burger
Pulled-pork burger

note.zh: � Rim Trail 往西 400 m

notes.en: Ten minutes after lunch: Kolb Studio on the rim, the switchbacks at Bright Angel trailhead, then the bus by Bright Angel Lodge
notes.zh: 饭后 10 分钟：Kolb Studio 外看崖边老照相馆，在 Bright Angel Trailhead 往下看之字步道，然后在 Bright Angel Lodge 旁上巴士

text.en: The Kolb brothers' 1904 photo studio hanging on the rim
text.zh: Kolb 兄弟 1904 年摄影工作室挂在崖边

text.en: Bright Angel Trail switchbacks and the first tunnel
text.zh: Bright Angel Trail 之字弯与第一个隧道

note.zh: � 免费园区巴士 Village Route (Blue) 在 Bright Angel Lodge 附近上车 → Visitor Center（每 15–20 分钟）
� Desert View Drive（AZ-64 E）12 mi → 左转 Grandview Point；免费

notes.en: A 10-minute viewpoint, shortened
notes.zh: 观景 10 分钟（缩短）

hours.en: Road open, closed for a time if it snows

text.en: One of the highest viewpoints on the South Rim, pines right to the edge
text.zh: 南缘最高观景点之一，松林直到崖边

text.en: Horseshoe Mesa and the old mining trail
text.zh: 看 Horseshoe Mesa 和古老铜矿步道

note.zh: � Desert View Drive 往东 14 mi（Moran Point 不停）到 Desert View 停车场（顺便加油：24h 自助油泵）；免费

notes.en: Pick up the free tower ticket first. Last ticket issued at 3:40, last entry at 4:00, groups of 25 for 20 minutes. Then see the Colorado bend from the Desert View terrace
notes.zh: 先领免费上塔票（最后发票 3:40，最后入场 4:00，每批 25 人 20 分钟），上塔后在 Desert View 平台看 Colorado River 拐弯

hours.en: NPS: the upper level is open 9–5 when staffed. Last ticket at 3:40, last entry at 4:00
hours.zh: NPS：上层 9–5 视人手开放，最后发票 3:40、最后入场 4:00

text.zh: Mary Colter 1932 年石塔，内壁 Hopi 画家 Fred Kabotie 壁画

text.zh: 塔顶能看到 Colorado River 大弯与 Painted Desert

text.zh: Desert View 平台是南缘少数看得到河的点

note.zh: � Desert View Drive 往西 3 mi（往回开一小段）

notes.en: Grand Canyon sunset. On 11/28 sunset is about 5:13 PM
notes.zh: 大峡谷日落（11/28 日落约 5:13 PM）

text.en: The longest stretch of the Colorado visible from the South Rim, and Unkar Delta
text.zh: 南缘看河最长的一段 Colorado River 与 Unkar Delta

text.en: Grand Canyon Supergroup layers in color at sunset
text.zh: 日落时 Grand Canyon Supergroup 彩色岩层

text.en: Leave 10 minutes after sunset. The night drive is 2 hours
text.zh: 日落后 10 分钟就走（夜路 2 小时）

notes.en: Dinner. The dining room is open until 9 PM MST
notes.zh: 晚餐（餐厅开到 9 PM MST）
